name: ai-tells-auditor
description: Three skills for clearer prose, one per step from notes to finished text. ai-tells-writer drafts from notes in a chosen voice and can build a voice from your writing. ai-tells-auditor flags AI tells and autopilot writing: stock phrases, inflated words, filler, hedges, em dashes, uniform rhythm, and content problems a linter can't see. ai-tells-editor edits a draft against the notes it came from, cutting without adding.
